thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike detected in 'inference.latency.p95' across us-west clusters — current rate 420/s (baseline ~18/s). Auto-escalation to oncall triggered. :rotating_light:

maria (sre): seeing same. lots of small noisy alerts + a few real latency spikes. suspecting cascading cache misses after rollout.

lee (infra): rolling back canary of q2-quantize-2 model in us-west-2 now. will post when done.

sam (devops): creating temporary dedupe rule to suppress noisy duplicates for next 2h. rule: "group by trace_id and route to single alert; suppress repeats within 120s". applying to alertset infer-p95-usw.

tim (oncall): assigned incident owner: @maria (sre). I'll stay on channel for handoff. Aya, any customer-facing impact reported?

aya (product-ops): no direct tickets yet, but two customers reported increased latency on status page. Created ticket INC-4821 and flagged CS to standby.

maria (sre): quick mitigation plan: 1) rollback canary (lee), 2) enable prefix KV cache pinning for heavy tenants (sam), 3) temporarily increase alert thresholds to p95>500ms for noisier routes, 4) dashboard + runbook link in thread.

lee (infra): canary rollback complete. CPU on serving nodes back to baseline after 3m.

sam (devops): applied dedupe rule and set PD rate limit to 1/min per alert fingerprint. also added short-term alert mute for low-severity noisy alerts (:30m).

maria (sre): updated temporary thresholds: infer-p95-usw > 500ms -> severity=high; infer-p95-usw between 300-500ms -> severity=warning but suppressed to PD. Pushed change to alerts repo: 
```
# alerts/inference/p95.rules
- name: infer-p95-usw
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_latency_seconds_bucket[1m])) by (le, model, zone))
  labels:
    severity: high
  for: 1m
  annotations:
    runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-p95
```

maria (sre): added a temporary column on the infra dashboard to surface cache miss ratio and canary tag. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/inf-p95/alert-surge-debug

aya (product-ops): posting a short status update to status.redwood.ai: "Investigating increased inference latency in US-West; mitigations in progress. Some customers may see transient delays."

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: suppression active for 30m on rule infer-p95-usw (rate-limit=1/min, dedupe=fingerprint).

tim (oncall): handing off next 60m to maria for follow-up. I'll stay available for PD noise if it re-fires.

maria (sre): will track customer tickets and revert thresholds after stability window (30m of p95 < 300ms). if we hit regressions will open rollback/qa postmortem.

lee (infra): one note — observed a spike in db connection churn correlated with canary. adding a longer lived metric panel for connection recycle rate.

sam (devops): creating follow-up tasks: TKT-2099 add dedupe fingerprinting to all inference alerts; TKT-2100 add PD routing to oncall group instead of individual; TKT-2101 dashboard panel for prefix cache hit ratio.

aya (product-ops): once stabilized, can we schedule a 1-pager for customers explaining what happened and what we've changed? helps with transparency.

maria (sre): agreed. I'll draft and share in #customer-success.

tim (oncall): update: 25m after rollback, p95 back to ~180ms. keeping dedupe + rate limits for 1h then reassess. good job team. :tada:
